title: The rate book
description: Rate book 2026.08 — identical to the one in the native sample. Only the keys that address it differ, because the message model differs.

title: Driver age
description: Whole years on the message date, for the party that drives the car. The role predicate picks that party by partyRoleCode instead of by position — AFD does not fix the order of the parties collection. dateDiff counts birthdays, so it is right on the birthday and right in a leap year.

title: Licence years
description: Years since the driving licence was issued — it feeds the acceptance table.

title: Vehicle age
description: Years since the date of first admission — what decides whether ALLRISK is still available.

title: AFD names onto rate-book keys
description: The whole mapping layer, in one object. bmStep is claim-free years plus two held inside the ladder's 1-20 range — a twenty-row decisionTable until clamp existed. From here down the lookup is identical to the native sample's.

title: Eight tables, one command
description: Region, vehicle, bonus-malus, payment term, excess, security, parking and usage. Byte for byte the same block as in the native sample — the mapping above is what absorbed the difference in message model.

title: Driver age band
description: Bands are ranges, and a range is rule text — so this stays a table where the bonus-malus step became a sum.

title: Annual mileage band
description: Five bands over the declared kilometres per year.

title: Granted coverage code
description: ALLRISK on a car older than ten years is granted as BEPERKTCASCO. The downgraded flag becomes an acceptance clause further down.

title: Acceptance
description: Four inputs, first match wins, and defaultResults is the accept path — so the rules only have to state the exceptions.

results.reason: Regelmatige bestuurder is jonger dan 18 jaar.
Minder dan 1 jaar in het bezit van het rijbewijs — handmatige acceptatie.
Meer dan 30.000 km per jaar — handmatige acceptatie.

title: Price the additional coverages
description: In place, in the message itself: WA and casco carry no tariff row and are left untouched.

title: Additional coverages per month
description: Only the additional coverages carry a premium at this point, so this wildcard sum hits exactly those.

title: Liability premium
description: Six rating factors over the WA base premium. multiply is variadic like sum, so the whole product is one call and nothing round-trips through an expression string.

title: Casco premium
description: Three outcomes in one expression, where nested ifElse blocks used to take four levels: CASCO carries the bonus-malus and excess factors, BEPERKTCASCO does not, GEEN is zero. =if evaluates only the branch it picks.

title: Net per month
description: Liability plus casco plus additional covers — everything is monthly until the next line.

title: Net per term
description: Months in the chosen premium frequency, times the term surcharge.

title: Taxable base
description: Policy costs are taxed with the premium.

title: Assurantiebelasting
description: 21% over premium plus policy costs.

title: Gross per term
description: What is actually collected each term.

title: Gross per year
description: The comparison figure the customer asked for.

title: WA coverage entity
description: Completed with the rated premium. statusCode is spelled out here so it keeps its place in the entity; the wildcard write below is for the entities that came in with the request.

title: Casco coverage entity
description: Carries the granted code, which is not always the requested one.

title: Accept every coverage line
description: One wildcard write instead of one per coverage.

title: The message changes type
description: A quotation request goes out as a policy creation message.

title: Policy status
description: The acceptance table's verdict, on the policy entity.

title: Insurer code
description: From the rate book's rules block.

title: Product name
description: Also from the rate book — the product is part of the rating, not of the request.

title: Granted coverage code
description: Beside requestedCoverageCode, which the message already carried.

title: Expiry date
description: Same day, next year — dateAdd does the calendar arithmetic that used to be string slicing.

title: Contract duration
description: One year, matching the expiry date above.

title: Risk profile
description: Insurer extension, not an AFD entity: every factor that priced this policy, so the premium can be explained back to the customer.

title: Premium entity
description: Every intermediate figure, in the order the rating model produces them.

title: Acceptance entity
description: The total excess is the voluntary one plus the young-driver surcharge when it applies — one =if, where it used to be a second put inside the clause block below.

title: Young-driver clause
description: Under 24: extra own risk on casco claims, stated on the policy.

ifScript.title: JONGE-BESTUURDER
ifScript.description: clauses is created by writing into it — a path that does not exist yet is a container.

value.clauseText: Regelmatige bestuurder is jonger dan 24 jaar: extra eigen risico van toepassing op cascoschade.

title: Cover-downgrade clause
description: The granted-coverage table set this flag; the message has to say so in words.

ifScript.title: DEKKING-AANGEPAST
ifScript.description: concat builds the sentence from the requested code, the vehicle age and the granted description.

value.clauseText: =concat('Aangevraagde dekking ',$.afdMessage.policy.requestedCoverageCode,' is niet mogelijk voor een voertuig van ',$.calc.vehicleAge,' jaar; toegekend is ',$.calc.grantedCoverDescription,'.')

title: Drop the working area
description: Scratch space, not part of the message.

title: Drop the rate book
description: It came from the script, so it leaves with it.
